name: Duke Sucellus

mechanics.name: Awakening
mechanics.description: He starts the fight asleep and cannot be hurt. Two doses of arder-musca poison, brewed from the salt and mushrooms around the asylum, are what wake him.
mechanics.counterplay: Gather the powders and salt before the fight starts, and mix them with the pestle in the arena.

mechanics.name: Arm Slam
mechanics.description: In melee range he raises both arms, throwing up icicles across the tiles around him, then brings them down on a single tile. The slam lands whatever your defences are.
mechanics.counterplay: Pray Protect from Melee and stand behind a pillar. The pillar takes the slam entirely.

mechanics.name: Blue Projectiles
mechanics.description: Out of melee range he throws blue orbs instead, and they hurt badly even when you are praying against them.
mechanics.counterplay: Stay in melee range or behind a pillar so he never reaches for this one.

mechanics.name: Freezing Gaze
mechanics.description: Every fifth attack his eye opens. Five ticks later anyone not behind a pillar takes an enormous hit.
mechanics.counterplay: Get behind a pillar as soon as the message appears. There is time for one more attack first.

mechanics.name: Gas Flares
mechanics.description: He spits gas towards the nearest vent, and it lingers there hurting anyone standing in it. Above half health he sends one flare, below it two.
mechanics.counterplay: Move to the opposite pillar. A slayer helmet or gas mask cuts the damage.

mechanics.name: Enrage
mechanics.description: At a quarter health he speeds up by a tick, dropping onto a four tick cycle.
mechanics.counterplay: Switch to a four tick weapon, or keep a five tick one and attack every other cycle.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). All eight Duke Sucellus npc ids are in npcIds, because he transforms between sleeping and awake states rather than respawning, and an npc transform has to be tracked as the boss for his animations to keep matching (docs/DECISIONS.md D17). Animations are the NPC_DUKE_SUCELLUS01_* set, all unambiguous gameval names: WAKE_UP 10179, ATTACK_MELEE 10176, MAGIC_ATTACK 10177, MAGIC_ATTACK_FASTER 10178 and SIGHT_ATTACK 10180. Projectiles VFX_DUKE_SUCELLUS_ATTACK_MAGIC_PROJECTILE_01 2434 and PROJANIM_DUKE_SPIT_01 2436 are curated because each carries an explicit projectile suffix in Jagex's own name, which is the bar for a projectile trigger in this wave; VFX_DUKE_SUCELLUS_ATTACK_MAGIC_PROJECTILE_IMPACT_01 2435 and the four SPOTANIM_DUKE_VENT_01_SPAWN ids 10192 through 10195 are graphics and are deliberately left out, since a graphic trigger has no source actor to check (D17) and discovery never revokes (D18). GAS FLARES DETECT ON A PROJECTILE ALONE, with no animation to back it up, because the cache names no gas-spit sequence for him; PROJANIM_DUKE_SPIT_01 2436 is read as the gas flare on the strength of its name, which is an inference. THIS BOSS'S ANIMATIONS ARE SKELETAL, SO THE PREVIEW VALUES ARE AN ESTIMATE, NOT ARITHMETIC (docs/DECISIONS.md D36). A skeletal sequence has no frames for FitZoom to walk, so its per-frame extents come back empty and the offline fit collapses to the model's bind pose. The method used here is the one Doom of Mokhaiotl already shipped under: take the zoom from struct 4586, the Combat Achievements screen's own entry for this boss, which pins model 47192 at zoom 3000, and compute shiftY from the bind pose extents at that zoom. Reproducing Doom's shipped shiftY of 41 from its own struct zoom of 2500 is what established the method. The zoom then had to be raised from 3000 to 3486 because the bind-pose shiftY at 3000 projected past the 70px half-box ceiling BundledBossDataTest enforces, so it is the smallest zoom that brings shiftY to 68. THE PREVIEW PINS modelId 47192 RATHER THAN RESOLVING THROUGH npcId, because the npc's own models[0] is 49194 and the two are different meshes: the CA struct's is the merged whole boss. Taking models[0] instead is what produced the half-rendered General Graardor fixed in issue #89. Every mechanic shares one zoom and shiftY because they all render the same model, exactly as Doom's eleven mechanics do. staticFallback is false on all six; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game, and for a skeletal boss that check matters more than usual. The collection log page is titled 'Duke Sucellus', matching 'name'.
